prerequisites: A ServerPlayer carrying named and component-bearing items, exact experience, and damaged equipment
Default configuration followed by experience and durability penalties enabled
steps: Record the real keepInventory rule, inventory, experience, equipment damage, effects, and dropped entities
Execute a real final death, clone, and respawn with default configuration
Repeat with a known experience ratio and durability loss, including Integer.MAX_VALUE loss
assertions: The real keepInventory rule is unchanged after every success or exception path
Default configuration changes none of experience, durability, or effects and creates no item drops
Enabled experience retention equals floor(totalExperience * ratio)
Each stack identity is damaged at most once and damage remains within the configured durability boundary

prerequisites: A player with a non-empty death streak
steps: Save player data and reload it
Clone the player through a real death respawn
Advance game time to one tick before and exactly at resetTicks
assertions: deaths and lastDeathGameTime survive save/load and death clone exactly
The streak advances before resetTicks and resets exactly at resetTicks
A cancelled or non-final death does not advance the streak
